title: Senior Suppliers Development Engineer
description:
The Supplier Development and Maturity Engineer plays a key and highly strategic role in improving the maturity of Arabelle Solutions’ suppliers. The mission is to sustainably elevate performance, quality, and nuclear safety standards of industrial partners to secure critical projects in a demanding environment.
   

  

 This role focuses on the structural development of suppliers, addressing the core elements that determine supplier reliability:
   

  

* Excellence of the Quality Management System
* Strengthening of nuclear safety culture and requirements
* Organizational and documentation robustness, including sub\-tier supplier
* management
* Continuous improvement capability and risk control


 The role is suited for a structured and rigorous engineer with strong quality expertise, mastering the industrial production process from order intake to delivery. With excellent interpersonal skills, the individual acts as a true change driver, supporting suppliers through a Lean approach.
   

  

 Working closely with internal experts, the Supplier Development Engineer assesses supplier maturity by conducting audits, analyzing organization, and identifying risks and weak signals. Supported by sourcing strategy, he/she develops and leads high\-impact development plans (including operational aspects), supports suppliers in transforming their practices, and ensures the effectiveness of implemented actions.
   

  

**The Suppliers Covered Include**
* New Arabelle Solutions suppliers
* Current suppliers with quality performance issues
* Strategic suppliers for the company


 This role directly contributes to supplier panel maturity, nuclear supply chain reliability, and the success of Arabelle Solutions projects.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Contribute to and validate the global supplier selection strategy with sourcing teams
* Prepare, plan, and conduct assessment audits (ISO 9001, ISO 19443, customer requirements, internal standards) at supplier sites
* Evaluate and challenge suppliers’ organizational structure and processes to meet nuclear technical and administrative requirements; assess safety culture (organization, supply chain monitoring, competency management, process robustness, documentation control)
* Identify and mitigate gaps, weak signals, and risks affecting quality or safety
* Deliver structured and actionable reports
* Coordinate with internal technical experts for supplier\-related actions
* Develop pragmatic and measurable supplier development plans (actions, deadlines, KPIs)
* Drive supplier maturity improvement through Lean coaching, follow\-up, and effectiveness assessment
* Promote best practices while respecting confidentiality rules
* Develop and improve supplier qualification, maturity standards, and development programs, leveraging synergies within the EDF Group


**Required Skills**
**Technical Skills**
* Training or certification in nuclear safety / ISO 19443 is a plus
* Minimum 10 years of experience in quality, audits, or supplier development, ideally in regulated industries (nuclear, energy, rail, aerospace)
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes
* Strong command of Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001 required)
* Good understanding of nuclear safety culture
* Expertise in operational excellence in manufacturing
* Experience in QMS, organizational and process audits
* Strong knowledge of industrial production processes


**Behavioral Skills**
* Strong leadership and change management capability
* Excellent communication, listening, analytical and synthesis skills
* Rigor, autonomy, and initiative
* Strong interpersonal skills with diverse stakeholders
* Proactive mindset


**Profile And Requirements**
* Engineering degree or equivalent
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); French is a plus


**WORKING CONDITIONS**
* Willingness to travel to supplier sites


 Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.
   

  

 At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being.
   

  

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

 Manage and execute deliverables specific to the region as well as Global deliverables, with reporting both locally and into the Global Program.

 Help with ensuring Global Change Standards, Enterprise Procedures are followed for the project and that documentation meets Enterprise and line of business requirements.
   

  

 Help with managing project scope, timeline, and budget.
   

  

 Help with managing production of meeting decks and tracking meeting minutes and actions

 Experience of producing test metrics/MI for senior management

**Certifications If any**

 A strong change management or transaction reporting experience is required, including the ability to prioritize work and meet deadlines and work in a highly matrixed organization

title: Field Operations Auditor
description:
**Job Description (JD)** 
  
 



**Position: Field Operations Auditor / Operations Excellence Specialist** 
  
 



**Department:** 
 Operations 
 



**Location:** 
 Gandhinagar, Gujarat (Pan India Travel) 
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time 
 



**Experience:** 
 3–4 Years 
 



**About the Role** 
  
 



 We are looking for a proactive, technically strong, and highly disciplined
 **Field Operations Auditor / Operations Excellence Specialist** 
 to ensure the operational excellence of our deployed robotic fleet across India. 
 



 This is a field\-intensive role where the selected candidate will travel extensively to audit robot health, evaluate field operations, assess manpower performance, interact with clients and mall authorities, and ensure every deployment location maintains the highest operational standards. 
 



 The person will act as the
 **eyes and ears of the Operations Department** 
 , taking complete ownership of field operations and ensuring that robots, manpower, documentation, and customer experience consistently meet company expectations. 
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
  
 


* Conduct periodic audits of deployed robots across all assigned locations.
* Inspect overall robot health, including hardware, software, navigation, sensors, battery, charging systems, and accessories.
* Perform preventive maintenance inspections and ensure maintenance schedules are followed.
* Identify hardware and software issues, perform initial troubleshooting, and coordinate with technical teams for timely resolution.
* Verify robot functionality, navigation accuracy, customer interaction, and overall operational performance.
* Ensure all robots comply with company SOPs, operational standards, and safety guidelines.
* Verify robot cleanliness, branding, charging stations, and overall presentation at deployment sites.
* Monitor robot uptime and proactively identify potential failures before they impact operations.
* Evaluate the performance of field engineers and on\-site manpower based on technical knowledge, troubleshooting ability, response time, documentation, professionalism, ownership, and SOP compliance.
* Conduct performance audits and provide structured feedback and improvement recommendations.
* Interact with mall management, facility teams, and client representatives to collect operational feedback and resolve concerns.
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with clients and stakeholders.
* Investigate robot breakdowns, operational incidents, and customer complaints, and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Prepare detailed audit reports with observations, photographs, corrective actions, and recommendations.
* Verify inventory, spare parts availability, tools, batteries, chargers, and asset records at each deployment location.
* Ensure all deployment, maintenance, service, and audit documentation is accurate, complete, and up to date.
* Track open issues and ensure timely closure through effective coordination with Operations, Technical Support, Product, and Logistics teams.
* Identify recurring operational challenges and recommend improvements to deployment processes, maintenance practices, SOPs, and overall operational efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, safety regulations, and quality standards during all field activities.
* Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly audit reports, performance trackers, and operational dashboards.
* Travel extensively across India to conduct audits, inspections, preventive maintenance reviews, and operational assessments.
* Take complete ownership of assigned locations and ensure the highest standards of robot performance, field execution, and customer satisfaction.



**Required Qualifications** 
  
 



**Education** 
  
 


* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (
 **Mandatory** 
 )
* MBA in Operations, Supply Chain, or Project Management (
 **Preferred)**



**Required Skills** 
  
 



**Technical Skills** 
  
 


* Strong understanding of robotics systems, electronics, mechanical assemblies, and automation equipment.
* Hands\-on experience in hardware troubleshooting and preventive maintenance.
* Basic understanding of Linux, networking, and software diagnostics.
* Knowledge of inventory management and asset tracking.
* Experience with operational documentation and reporting.
* Ability to perform technical inspections and identify root causes of failures.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and reporting tools.



**Soft Skills** 
  
 


* Excellent observation and analytical skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High level of ownership and accountability.
* Strong planning, coordination, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Professional client handling and relationship management.
* Adaptability to work in dynamic field environments.
* Strong time management and multitasking skills.



**Travel Requirement** 
  
 


* Extensive travel across India (70–90%).
* Willingness to stay at deployment locations for extended periods whenever required.
* Flexible to work on weekends, holidays, or outside business hours during critical operational activities.



**Preferred Candidate Profile** 
  
 



 We are looking for someone who: 
 


* Takes complete ownership of field operations and believes in accountability.
* Has a passion for travelling and working on\-site.
* Can independently manage multiple deployment locations.
* Has strong technical troubleshooting capabilities.
* Is detail\-oriented and process\-driven.
* Can identify operational risks before they become critical issues.
* Maintains excellent relationships with clients, mall management, and internal teams.
* Is disciplined in documentation, reporting, and follow\-up.
* Has a continuous improvement mindset and drives operational excellence.



**Why Join Us?** 
  
 


* Opportunity to work with one of India's fastest\-growing robotics deployment companies.
* High\-impact role with complete ownership of Pan\-India field operations.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge autonomous robotic technologies.
* Work with premium malls, commercial properties, and enterprise clients across India.
* Opportunity to influence operational strategy and improve nationwide deployment quality.
* Fast career growth into Regional Operations Manager, National Operations Manager, or Operations Excellence Lead roles.
* Dynamic, collaborative, and innovation\-driven work culture.

title: Quality Manager
description:
**About This Job**
**MOBA Mobile Automation**
**Location:** 
 Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Appliances, Electrical, and Electronics Manufacturing
   

  

**Job Description**
 Quality Manager – MOBA India
   

  

 Company: MOBA Mobile Automation India Pvt. Ltd.
   

  

 Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat
   

  

 Experience: 7\-10 years
   

  

 Industry: Off\-Highway Electronics / OEM Supply / Industrial Manufacturing
   

  

**About MOBA India**
 MOBA India is part of MOBA Mobile Automation AG, Germany, a globally respected brand in the off\-highway electronics and automation industry with nearly 50 years of innovation. The company serves leading OEMs across road construction, mining, agriculture, and aerial work platforms, and in India has grown from a small team in 2004 to a 170\+ member organization serving globally recognized customers such as L\&T, Ammann, Volvo, JCB, CNH, and Atlas Copco.
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 MOBA India is looking for an experienced Quality Manager to build and lead the quality function from the ground up. This role is not limited to end\-of\-line inspection; it requires establishing a structured Quality Management System, introducing Total Quality Management practices, building quality processes and documentation, leading internal audits, and embedding quality across incoming, in\-process, final inspection, supplier quality, customer quality, and continuous improvement activities in line with standard manufacturing expectations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Build, implement, and continuously improve the company Quality Management System covering process definition, documentation, control, compliance, and governance.
* Develop quality foundation documents including SOPs, inspection standards, process maps, quality control plans, check sheets, work instructions, nonconformity handling formats, CAPA systems, deviation control, and controlled records.
* Move the organization beyond end\-of\-line inspection by introducing incoming quality control, in\-process quality checks, stage\-wise inspection criteria, process audits, and structured quality feedback loops with production and engineering.
* Deploy practical quality tools such as Control Plan, PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, SPC, MSA, 8D, root cause analysis, and corrective/preventive action systems as relevant to OEM\-facing manufacturing.
* Lead internal audits, support customer audits, prepare the organization for external certification or compliance reviews, and drive closure of audit findings across functions.
* Establish quality KPIs such as rejection ppm, first pass yield, rework, supplier defects, field failures, customer complaints, warranty trends, and CAPA closure effectiveness, with regular reporting to management.
* Work closely with Production, Stores, SCM, Engineering, Service, and Management to ensure quality is built into processes rather than checked only at dispatch.
* Develop supplier quality practices including supplier qualification support, incoming inspection standards, supplier corrective action, and supplier performance monitoring.
* Ensure calibration planning, measurement system discipline, traceability, and controlled use of gauges, fixtures, and testing equipment.
* Build organization\-wide quality awareness through training, documentation discipline, audit readiness, and practical implementation of standard quality practices on the shop floor.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, Production, or related engineering discipline; master’s degree preferred.
* 7–10 years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, preferably in industrial electronics, automotive components, off\-highway equipment, or OEM\-facing manufacturing environments.
* Proven experience in setting up or significantly strengthening a quality system from scratch, not only managing final inspection activities.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of ISO 9001 and practical implementation of process\-based QMS in manufacturing.
* Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, Control Plan, FMEA, SPC, MSA, CAPA, NCR, 8D, and internal audit systems.
* Experience in handling customer quality expectations, audit preparation, and closure of nonconformities through cross\-functional coordination.
* Strong leadership, communication, documentation, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor qualification in ISO 9001 preferred.
* Exposure to IATF 16949\-style core tools or similar OEM quality expectations is highly desirable.
* Experience in electronics assembly, rugged industrial products, or low\-to\-medium volume OEM supply environments is an added advantage.

description:
L’Ingénieur développement et maturité des fournisseurs joue un rôle clé et hautement stratégique dans la montée en maturité des fournisseurs d’Arabelle Solutions. Sa mission : élever durablement le niveau de performance, de qualité et de sûreté nucléaire de nos partenaires industriels afin de sécuriser des projets critiques dans un environnement exigeant.
   

  

 Ce Poste Se Concentre Sur Le Développement Structurel Des Fournisseurs. Il Intervient Au Cœur Des Fondamentaux Qui Conditionnent La Fiabilité D’un Fournisseur
   

  

* Excellence du système de management de la qualité
* Renforcement de la culture et des exigences de sûreté nucléaire
* Robustesse organisationnelle, documentaire et suivi des sous\-traitants
* Capacité d’amélioration continue et de maîtrise des risques


 Le rôle s’adresse à un(e) ingénieur(e) structuré(e), rigoureux(se), doté(e) d’une forte culture qualité, maîtrisant les étapes du processus industriel de production, de la prise de commande à la livraison. Doté(e) d’un excellent relationnel, la personne sera capable d’être un véritable pilote du changement auprès de nos fournisseurs en les accompagnant dans une démarche Lean.
   

  

 En lien direct avec les experts internes, l’Ingénieur Développement Fournisseurs évalue la maturité des fournisseurs en menant des audits, en analysant leur organisation et en identifiant les risques et les potentiels signaux faibles. Appuyé par la stratégie sourcing, il/elle construit et pilote des plans de développement à fort impact (y compris opérationnels), accompagne les fournisseurs dans la transformation de leurs pratiques et garantit l’efficacité des actions engagées.
   

  

**Les Fournisseurs Suivis Sont**
* Les nouveaux fournisseurs d’Arabelle Solutions
* Les fournisseurs actuels présentant des problématiques de performance qualité
* Les fournisseurs stratégiques pour l’entreprise


 Son action contribue directement à la montée en maturité du panel fournisseurs, à la fiabilité de la supply chain nucléaire et à la réussite des projets d’Arabelle Solutions.
   

  

**MISSIONS ET ACTIVITÉS PRINCIPALES**
* Participer et valider la stratégie globale de sélection des fournisseurs avec les équipes sourcing
* Préparer, planifier et conduire des audits d’évaluation (ISO 9001, ISO 19443, exigences clients, référentiels internes) chez les fournisseurs
* Évaluer et challenger la structure organisationnelle et les processus des fournisseurs afin de répondre aux exigences techniques et administratives liées aux commandes nucléaires ; réaliser des évaluations de culture sûreté (organisation, suivi de la supply chain, gestion des compétences, robustesse des procédés, maîtrise documentaire)
* Identifier et mitiger les écarts, les signaux faibles et les risques pouvant impacter la qualité ou la sûreté
* Rédiger des rapports structurés, argumentés et exploitables
* Assurer l’interface avec les experts techniques internes pour coordonner les actions fournisseurs
* Construire avec les fournisseurs des plans de développement pragmatiques et mesurables (actions, échéances, indicateurs)
* Contribuer à la montée en maturité du panel fournisseurs : accompagnement Lean, coaching, suivi des actions et évaluation de leur efficacité
* Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques dans le respect des règles de confidentialité
* Construire et améliorer les standards de qualification, de maturité et les programmes de développement fournisseurs, en favorisant les synergies avec les entités du groupe EDF


**Compétences techniques**
* Diplôme d’Ingénieur ou formation équivalente
* Expérience de 10 ans minimum en qualité, audit ou développement fournisseurs, idéalement dans un environnement réglementé (nucléaire, énergie, ferroviaire, aéronautique)
* Maîtrise des systèmes de management de la qualité, avec une excellente connaissance de la norme ISO 9001
* Certification ou formation en sûreté nucléaire et/ou ISO 19443 fortement appréciée
* Bonne compréhension des exigences et de la culture de sûreté nucléaire
* Solide connaissance des procédés de fabrication et des environnements industriels de production
* Expertise en audits qualité, audits organisationnels et audits de processus
* Maîtrise des principes d’excellence opérationnelle appliqués à la fabrication
* Très bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à la performance et à la conformité des fournisseurs
* Maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral


**Compétences comportementales**
* Leadership transverse et capacité à fédérer les parties prenantes
* Aptitude à accompagner le changement et à piloter des actions d’amélioration
* Excellentes capacités de communication, d’écoute et de négociation
* Esprit d’analyse et de synthèse développé
* Rigueur, autonomie et sens des responsabilités
* Forte capacité d’adaptation et aisance relationnelle avec des interlocuteurs variés
* Force de proposition et orientation résultats
* Déplacements réguliers à prévoir chez les fournisseurs
* Intervention dans un contexte industriel exigeant et fortement réglementé
* Collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et internationales


 Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.
   

  

 At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

title: Production Quality Assurance Specialist - Incoming Quality
description:
Drive and coordinate Quality Control activities for Incoming Inspection are to ensure zero shop complaints and to improve in overall inspection processes.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Knowledge about basic EHS guidelines/Environmental aspect and Risk related to inspection activities on Machines and during Assembly
* Knowledge about Risk related to chemical management related to Nondestructive testing and able to interpret MSDS related to associated chemicals.
* Initiate /support different environmental projects related to 3R’s (reduce/reuse/recycle).
* Report all Incidents / Accidents / Events / Spill / Leak as per the organization requirement.
* In depth knowledge about Machining and Assembly process preferably from Steam Turbine Manufacturing Processes
* Well conversant for using of Measuring instrument like Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Bore Gauges etc..
* In\-depth knowledge about the Steam Turbine manufacturing process and quality requirements
* Able to read and interpret Engineering drawing and geometrical tolerances requirement
* Able to detect any counter fraudulent inspection report received from Supplier or during inspection of bought out items
* Review of Supplier documentation/EOMR
* Raise flag for any non\-conformance/process deviations
* Hands on experience on QM Module of SAP
* Well convergent with manufacturing process like Machining, Assembly and Fabrication of Steam Turbine Components
* Create awareness among team to raise stop work/Quality Concern on small deviations
* Able to communicate on deviation with the sourcing/supplier/supplier quality.
* Preparation of Visual inspection reports
* Carryout “C” class component inspection and prepare dimension inspection report.
* Work as a bridge between shop quality team and sourcing quality team.
* Monitor Issues identified during shop and work with sourcing to improve the process at supplier end.


**Basic Qualifications(requirements)**
* Diploma/B.E/Btech in Mechanical Engineering.
* 5\-7 Years of Experience in incoming Quality.
* Well convergent with SAP/MTA/Microsoft Office tools (Advance understanding needed)


**Desired Qualifications**
* NDT Level II in LPT/MPT as per ASNT.


 Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.
   

  

 At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.
